snippet.title: Lootbound | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Lootbound is a tactical roguelite with turn-based combat, loot management and D&D elements set in a dark fantasy world. Fight dangerous enemies, collect epic loot, recruit allies and lead them on a path of adventure.

Available now on Steam and XBOX

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3091140/Lootbound/
XBOX: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/lootbound/9PDKMDGFPR2N
